say:0:1013501001:0.text:
... I... Um, never mind.
Ah, I can't hold in my curiosity anymore! I-I need to get some answers!
say:0:1013501001:0.source_cn: 其实……没什么……\n不行啊！受不了！我、我必须得问清...

say:1:1013501002:0.text: Temesia, what's up between you and Atalanta? Were you friends before?
say:1:1013501002:0.source_cn: 特弥希娅，你跟阿塔兰忒到底是怎么回事？你们原来是朋友吗？

say:2:1013501003:0.text: Oh, Lucius! Even the magister is signaling you to drop it!
say:2:1013501003:0.source_cn: 啊啊啊卢修斯！主人都那么努力地给你使眼色让你别问了！
say:2:1013501003:0.male: Oh, Lucius! Even the magister is signaling you to drop it!
say:2:1013501003:0.female: Oh, Lucius! Even the magister is signaling you to drop it!

say:3:1013501004:0.text: It's fine. Lucius is my trusted comrade. He deserves an answer...
say:3:1013501004:0.source_cn: 无妨。卢修斯是我信任的战友，他的疑问当然有权得到解答……

say:2:1013502001:2.text: Atalanta and I... we were friends once.
say:2:1013502001:2.source_cn: 我与阿塔兰忒，我们的确曾是朋友。我从小向往艾雅……

say:3:1013502002:2.text: When I was young, blessed by Dura's grace, I became the lead singer in the nearby Temple choir.
say:3:1013502002:2.source_cn: 蒙仁慈的艾雅恩赐，我得以成为了附近圣堂唱诗班的领唱。

say:4:1013502003:1.text: One day, as I sang in my stiff choir gown, I spotted a new face—a stray child.
say:4:1013502003:1.source_cn: 就在我穿着浆得硬硬的礼服裙唱歌的某一天，瞥见了一个生面...

say:5:1013502004:2.text: She was wandering around the Temple, and that same day there was a theft. Without proof, they just locked her up.
say:5:1013502004:2.source_cn: 她在圣堂中徘徊不去，恰逢当天发生窃案，神职者们未经取证...

choice_prompt:6:1013502004.text: She was wandering around the Temple, and that same day there was a theft. Without proof, they just locked her up.
choice_prompt:6:1013502004.source_cn: 她在圣堂中徘徊不去，恰逢当天发生窃案，神职者们未经取证，就直接把她关了起来。

say:7:1013502005:1.text: Yes. Hard to believe now, isn't it? Atalanta was actually pretty timid. They held her in a regular room, but she was terrified. She wouldn't even touch the food they brought her.
say:7:1013502005:1.source_cn: 嗯。现在看不出吧？阿塔其实很胆小的。关押她的地方只是个...

say:8:1013502006:1.text: Except when she saw me, she suddenly yelled, "Hey, get me out of this place! If it wasn't for your singing, I wouldn't be here!"
say:8:1013502006:1.source_cn: 唯独在看到我的时候，突然凶巴巴地大喊——“喂，快让我离...

say:9:1013502007:1.text: I felt really guilty. Listening to hymns isn't a crime. What happened to Atalanta was so unfair... That's when I aimed to become a knight.
say:9:1013502007:1.source_cn: 我内疚极了。期望聆听圣歌绝非罪孽，发生在阿塔身上的事很...

say:10:1013502008:1.text: I didn't want that kind of thing to happen again. Clearly, I haven't done well enough...
say:10:1013502008:1.source_cn: 我不想让这种事再次发生。艾雅在上，显然，我做得还不够好……

say:11:1013502009:1.text: You two must have been really close...
say:11:1013502009:1.source_cn: 你们一定曾是很要好的朋友吧……

say:12:1013502010:1.text: ...We meant the world to each other.
say:12:1013502010:1.source_cn: ……对彼此而言，我们都曾无可替代。

say:0:1013503001:0.text: This is the Ancient Battlefield, where the golems first appeared.
say:0:1013503001:0.source_cn: 号称“魔偶最早出现的地方”，傀儡古战场……就是这里了。

say:1:1013503002:0.text: There are quite a few golems around! Magister, cover my back!
say:1:1013503002:0.source_cn: 这附近的魔偶还真不少！梅林大人，请来我盾后！
say:1:1013503002:0.male: There are quite a few golems around! Magister, cover my back!
say:1:1013503002:0.female: There are quite a few golems around! Magister, cover my back!

say:2:1013503003:0.text: Everyone, be careful. The golems are attacking!
say:2:1013503003:0.source_cn: 各位，谨慎小心。已经有魔偶攻过来了！

say:0:1013506001:0.text: Everyone okay? Those golems were different from the ones before...
say:0:1013506001:0.source_cn: 你们还好吧！刚才那些魔偶，战斗方式和我们之前遇到的不太...

say:1:1013506002:0.text: Is this what the Evergreen scholars meant? Let's investigate.
say:1:1013506002:0.source_cn: 这就是冬青学者们建议的原因吗？在此调查一下吧。
say:1:1013506002:0.male: Is this what the Evergreen scholars meant? Let's investigate.
say:1:1013506002:0.female: Is this what the Evergreen scholars meant? Let's investigate.

say:0:1013507001:0.source_cn: 魔偶的力量，相当紊乱啊。

say:1:1013507002:0.text: Yeah, they're like... when you're making cake and it accidentally splatters everywhere!
say:1:1013507002:0.source_cn: 是啊！乱七八糟的，简直就像是……像是……做姜饼到一半时...

say:3:1013507004:0.text: Stupid Chippy! I'm just saying these golems feel... incomplete?
say:3:1013507004:0.source_cn: 笨、笨蛋满满，我才不是饿了！只是想说，那些魔偶有种……...

say:0:1013508001:0.text: The golems we faced before seemed more like finished products.
say:0:1013508001:0.source_cn: 我们之前遇到的魔偶，似乎更接近于“成品”。

say:1:1013508002:0.text: Clearly, someone's secretly pulling the strings of the completed golems.
say:1:1013508002:0.source_cn: 那些”完整“魔偶的背后，显然有人在暗中操控。
say:1:1013508002:0.male: Clearly, someone's secretly pulling the strings of the completed golems.
say:1:1013508002:0.female: Clearly, someone's secretly pulling the strings of the completed golems.

say:2:1013508003:0.text: Someone's deliberately using them to attack civilians? How evil!
say:2:1013508003:0.source_cn: 故意控制它们去攻击民众？艾雅在上……一定要让我们揪出这...

say:0:1013509001:0.text: There's not much to investigate here, Magister Merlin. Should we keep going?
say:0:1013509001:0.source_cn: 这里没什么可调查的了，梅林大人。我们还是继续前行吧。
say:0:1013509001:0.male: There's not much to investigate here, Magister Merlin. Should we keep going?
say:0:1013509001:0.female: There's not much to investigate here, Magister Merlin. Should we keep going?

say:1:1013509002:0.text: Let's go. Seems like there's something up ahead.
say:1:1013509002:0.source_cn: 走吧。这条路的前方似乎还有些什么。
say:1:1013509002:0.male: Let's go. Seems like there's something up ahead.
say:1:1013509002:0.female: Let's go. Seems like there's something up ahead.

say:1:1013510001:1.text: Magister, look! There's a camp up ahead!
say:1:1013510001:1.male: Magister, look! There's a camp up ahead!
say:1:1013510001:1.female: Magister, look! There's a camp up ahead!

say:2:1013510002:1.text: Ha... ha... Chippy, aren't you tired?... Me? <sad>Of course I'm not tired at all!</sad>
say:2:1013510002:1.source_cn: <sad>呼……呼……满满，你已经累了想休息吗？</s...

say:3:1013510003:1.text: Huh? Chippy's not tired! But Hammie, you're looking a bit out of breath.
say:3:1013510003:1.source_cn: 啊？我不累！倒是漫漫，你还走得动吗？

say:4:1013510004:2.text: Don't underestimate me! I can... totally go on...
say:4:1013510004:2.source_cn: 哈……啊……我当然走得动！只是稍微有点喘！我、我这是魔...

choice_prompt:5:1013510004.text: Don't underestimate me! I can... totally go on...
choice_prompt:5:1013510004.source_cn: 哈……啊……我当然走得动！只是稍微有点喘！我、我这是魔法师平均体力嘛！

say:6:1013510005:1.source_cn: 梅林大人真是太体贴了！

say:8:1013510007:2.text: Hold on, look at the golems at the camp's entrance and those flags...
say:8:1013510007:2.source_cn: 等等，注意那片营地前的魔偶和营地的旗帜……梅林大人，你...
say:8:1013510007:2.male: Hold on, look at the golems at the camp's entrance and those flags...
say:8:1013510007:2.female: Hold on, look at the golems at the camp's entrance and those flags...

choice:5:0:1.text: I'm a bit tired too. Let's rest.
choice:5:0:1.male: I'm a bit tired too. Let's rest.
choice:5:0:1.female: I'm a bit tired too. Let's rest.

say:10:1013510006:1.text: Our magister continues to excel in every aspect!
say:10:1013510006:1.source_cn: 唔唔……梅林这样的大魔法师当然是例外！
say:10:1013510006:1.male: Our magister continues to excel in every aspect!
say:10:1013510006:1.female: Our magister continues to excel in every aspect!

say:0:1013511001:0.text: It seems like the golems outside the camp and inside are in a standoff.
say:0:1013511001:0.source_cn: 营地外的魔偶和里面的魔偶——好像在对峙？

say:1:1013511002:0.text: The ones outside seem different, they seem more unstable.
say:1:1013511002:0.source_cn: 虽然都是魔偶，营地外游荡的魔偶和里面的显然不，外面的看...
say:1:1013511002:0.male: The ones outside seem different, they seem more unstable.
say:1:1013511002:0.female: The ones outside seem different, they seem more unstable.

say:2:1013511003:0.text: It seems like we have to face those golems before entering the Syndicate's camp...
say:2:1013511003:0.source_cn: 看来要进入黑金的营地，就必须要从这些魔偶中穿过……
say:2:1013511003:0.male: It seems like we have to face those golems before entering the Syndicate's camp...
say:2:1013511003:0.female: It seems like we have to face those golems before entering the Syndicate's camp...

say:0:1013512001:0.text: Drop your weapons! Who are you people?!
say:0:1013512001:0.source_cn: 放下武器，你们是什么人！

say:1:1013512002:0.text: How dare you barge into the Adamant Syndicate's camp!
say:1:1013512002:0.source_cn: 竟敢擅闯黑金商会的营地！

say:1:1013513001:1.text: Magister, those we just defeated seem to be...
say:1:1013513001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，刚才我们打倒的应该是……
say:1:1013513001:1.male: Magister, those we just defeated seem to be...
say:1:1013513001:1.female: Magister, those we just defeated seem to be...

choice_prompt:2:1013513001.text: Magister, those we just defeated seem to be...
choice_prompt:2:1013513001.source_cn: 梅林大人，刚才我们打倒的应该是……
choice_prompt:2:1013513001.male: Magister, those we just defeated seem to be...
choice_prompt:2:1013513001.female: Magister, those we just defeated seem to be...

say:3:1013513002:0.text: Anyone associated with the Syndicate is a villain! And it's the responsibility of the commander of the Heroic Order, Chippy, to clear them out for our Magister!
say:3:1013513002:0.source_cn: 没错！是黑金商会的大坏蛋！替主人扫清拦路的坏蛋，就是骑...
say:3:1013513002:0.male: Anyone associated with the Syndicate is a villain! And it's the responsibility of the commander of the Heroic Order, Chippy, to clear them out for our Magister!
say:3:1013513002:0.female: Anyone associated with the Syndicate is a villain! And it's the responsibility of the commander of the Heroic Order, Chippy, to clear them out for our Magister!

say:4:1013513003:2.text: Looks like this is indeed the Adamant Syndicate's camp.
say:4:1013513003:2.source_cn: 看来，这里果然是黑金商会的营地。

say:6:1013513004:1.text: There are leftover golem parts here! Hmm... Why do they look familiar?
say:6:1013513004:1.source_cn: 这里还有魔偶的残骸！呃……只有我觉得有些眼熟吗？

say:7:1013513005:1.text: It's not the first time we've seen things related to golems in the Syndicate's camps...
say:7:1013513005:1.source_cn: 我们不是第一次在黑金的营地里，看到跟魔偶有关的物件了……

say:8:1013513006:1.text: Let's put our clues together and figure this out.
say:8:1013513006:1.source_cn: 结合之前的结论，调查看看吧。

say:1:1013514001:1.text: If the previous Syndicate stronghold was where they made the golem cores...
say:1:1013514001:1.source_cn: 如果说之前的黑金营寨，是生产魔偶能源核心的地方——

say:2:1013514002:1.text: Then this camp is where they assemble the golems.
say:2:1013514002:1.source_cn: 那么这里，就是为魔偶装配能源的地方。

say:3:1013514003:0.text: It might be difficult to activate these golems that have been dormant for years...
say:3:1013514003:0.source_cn: 可想而知，要想驱动尘封多年的魔偶，恐怕很难……一蹴而就。

say:4:1013514004:1.text: In order to get them to work, they've been conducting a lot of experiments...
say:4:1013514004:1.source_cn: 他们会进行实验。一次又一次。

choice_prompt:5:1013514004.text: In order to get them to work, they've been conducting a lot of experiments...
choice_prompt:5:1013514004.source_cn: 他们会进行实验。一次又一次。

say:6:1013514005:2.text: So, they picked this place because the Ancient Battlefield has the most sleeping golems?
say:6:1013514005:2.source_cn: 所以他们选择这里，也是因为傀儡古战场沉睡着最多的魔偶吗？

say:9:1013514006:2.text: Yes. They let these golems wander the ruins without considering the harm they might cause to nearby residents!
say:9:1013514006:2.source_cn: 是的，漫漫小姐。他们放任这些魔偶在遗迹群山上游荡，丝毫...

say:10:1013514007:1.text: Additionally, it seems like the so-called "successful pieces" for now are only sent to specific places to cause harm.
say:10:1013514007:1.source_cn: 毕竟，所谓“成功品”的用途——目前看来，也只是被派遣到...

say:11:1013514008:1.text: I can't believe the Syndicate would go to these lengths...
say:11:1013514008:1.source_cn: 黑金商会，居然能做到这种事……

choice:5:0:1.text: Creating flawed pieces in the process.
choice:5:0:1.male: Creating flawed pieces in the process.
choice:5:0:1.female: Creating flawed pieces in the process.

say:1:1013514102:0.text: I can't work for free. Just sell it to the Macon guy.
say:1:1013514102:0.source_cn: 活儿不能白干，还是卖给麦肯那小子吧。

say:2:1013515002:1.text: Are you blind? I'm assembling golems.
say:2:1013515002:1.source_cn: 去去去，没长眼啊？我在组装魔偶。

say:4:1013515003:2.text: Is the Adamant Syndicate forcing you to do this?
say:4:1013515003:2.source_cn: 是黑金商会胁迫你工作吗？

say:5:1013515004:1.text: Forcing me? Pah! I get good money for each golem, now get lost! Don't slow down my work!
say:5:1013515004:1.source_cn: 胁迫个屁，我这是计件工，一边去，别耽误我挣钱！

say:1:1013516001:2.text: Hmph. I'd much rather be doing something else right now.
say:1:1013516001:2.source_cn: 哼，早知道被派来这里，我还不如去运送货物呢。

say:2:1013516002:1.text: Miss, may I know what you're carrying?
say:2:1013516002:1.source_cn: 这位女士，请问你运送的是什么货物？

say:3:1013516003:1.text: Just contraptions I'm assembling... Let me tell you—
say:3:1013516003:1.source_cn: 呐，就我在组装的这些玩意儿。要我说——

say:4:1013516004:1.text: The stuff I'm assembling isn't that powerful. Nowhere near as strong as our boss!
say:4:1013516004:1.source_cn: 组装完的东西，也没那么能打嘛。还不如我们老大！

say:6:1013516005:2.text: Is your boss part of the Adamant Syndicate?
say:6:1013516005:2.source_cn: 你们的老大是黑金商会的人吗？

say:7:1013516006:1.text: No way! My amazing master was born under a blood moon, the first under the long night. He's the dictator of gold, king of silver hair, and lunar wildwolf!
say:7:1013516006:1.source_cn: 怎么可能，他可是血月降生，长夜第一人，掘金独裁者，银毛...

choice_prompt:8:1013516006.text: No way! My amazing master was born under a blood moon, the first under the long night. He's the dictator of gold, king of silver hair, and lunar wildwolf!
choice_prompt:8:1013516006.source_cn: 怎么可能，他可是血月降生，长夜第一人，掘金独裁者，银毛之主，月下狂狼！

say:9:1013516007:1.text: Don't disrespect the great Mauler wildwolf! Don't you know anything, you ignorant peasant?!
say:9:1013516007:1.source_cn: 一个人啊，伟大的蛮血狂狼！你们都不知道吗？孤陋寡闻！

say:10:1013516008:1.text: Get lost, I don't have time for you country bumpkins.
say:10:1013516008:1.source_cn: 走开吧，我不要跟你们这些土包子讲话了。

say:1:1013517001:1.text: Magister Merlin, even though we've confirmed the connection between the Adamant Syndicate and the golems' revival, there are still some mysteries left unsolved.
say:1:1013517001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，虽然我们已经确认了黑金商会和魔偶复苏的关系，...
say:1:1013517001:1.male: Magister Merlin, even though we've confirmed the connection between the Adamant Syndicate and the golems' revival, there are still some mysteries left unsolved.
say:1:1013517001:1.female: Magister Merlin, even though we've confirmed the connection between the Adamant Syndicate and the golems' revival, there are still some mysteries left unsolved.

say:2:1013517002:1.text: Like that guy with the super long title the lady just mentioned?
say:2:1013517002:1.source_cn: 比如刚刚那位女士提到的，头衔很长的老大？

say:3:1013517003:1.text: ...And how they're bringing the golems back on such a large scale and why they control them.
say:3:1013517003:1.source_cn: ……譬如魔偶如何大批量地复苏，以及控制他们的目的。

choice_prompt:4:1013517003.text: ...And how they're bringing the golems back on such a large scale and why they control them.
choice_prompt:4:1013517003.source_cn: ……譬如魔偶如何大批量地复苏，以及控制他们的目的。

say:5:1013517004:2.text: Exactly! What's driving those golems and what are the Adamant Syndicate up to—that's what we need to know!
say:5:1013517004:2.source_cn: 是啊！驱动魔偶的能源到底是什么，为什么会被黑金商会掌握...

choice_prompt:6:1013517004.text: Exactly! What's driving those golems and what are the Adamant Syndicate up to—that's what we need to know!
choice_prompt:6:1013517004.source_cn: 是啊！驱动魔偶的能源到底是什么，为什么会被黑金商会掌握——这才是关键！

say:7:1013517005:2.text: Do you think it might be linked to the Faith Stone?
say:7:1013517005:2.source_cn: 梅林大人，你想说，可能跟圣石有关，对吗？
say:7:1013517005:2.male: Do you think it might be linked to the Faith Stone?
say:7:1013517005:2.female: Do you think it might be linked to the Faith Stone?

say:8:1013517006:1.text: Admittedly, the Adamant Syndicate using the Faith Stone to reactivate the golems isn't out of the question.
say:8:1013517006:1.source_cn: 我无法驳倒你的猜想。必须承认，圣石被黑金商会利用重启魔...
say:8:1013517006:1.male: Admittedly, the Adamant Syndicate using the Faith Stone to reactivate the golems isn't out of the question.
say:8:1013517006:1.female: Admittedly, the Adamant Syndicate using the Faith Stone to reactivate the golems isn't out of the question.

choice_prompt:9:1013517006.text: Admittedly, the Adamant Syndicate using the Faith Stone to reactivate the golems isn't out of the question.
choice_prompt:9:1013517006.source_cn: 我无法驳倒你的猜想。必须承认，圣石被黑金商会利用重启魔偶这件事并非不可能。
choice_prompt:9:1013517006.male: Admittedly, the Adamant Syndicate using the Faith Stone to reactivate the golems isn't out of the question.
choice_prompt:9:1013517006.female: Admittedly, the Adamant Syndicate using the Faith Stone to reactivate the golems isn't out of the question.

say:10:1013517007:1.text: Right! If Atalanta is tied to the Adamant Syndicate, it makes sense!
say:10:1013517007:1.source_cn: 对啊！如果那位阿塔兰忒跟黑金商会有关联，就说得通了！

say:11:1013517008:1.text: It's definitely suspicious! Temesia caught Atalanta back then, but she didn't have the Faith Stone on her.
say:11:1013517008:1.source_cn: 我早就觉得奇怪了！当年，特弥希娅抓到了阿塔兰忒，却没有...

say:12:1013517009:1.text: If she took the Faith Stone and gave it to the Adamant Syndicate—
say:12:1013517009:1.source_cn: 要是她盗走圣石，辗转交给了黑金商会——

say:15:1013517011:1.text: I haven't seen her in years. I don't know where Atalanta has been, who she's met, or what she's done.
say:15:1013517011:1.source_cn: 我和她已经多年未见了。这些年，阿塔……兰忒去过哪里，见...

say:16:1013517012:1.text: But I just know she would never do something like that.
say:16:1013517012:1.source_cn: 我只知道，这种事她绝对做不出。

say:17:1013517013:1.text: She might never fully trust others. Even I, who she saw as a close friend, was betrayed by her. But she would never hurt anyone innocent.
say:17:1013517013:1.source_cn: 她或许永远不会真心信任他人，哪怕是将她视为挚友的我，都...

choice_prompt:18:1013517013.text: She might never fully trust others. Even I, who she saw as a close friend, was betrayed by her. But she would never hurt anyone innocent.
choice_prompt:18:1013517013.source_cn: 她或许永远不会真心信任他人，哪怕是将她视为挚友的我，都遭逢到背叛——但，她不会害人。

say:19:1013517014:2.text: Yes! Atalanta has been supportive of us from the start. She couldn't be a villain!
say:19:1013517014:2.source_cn: 是啊，主人！阿塔兰忒第一次见面就帮了我们，她绝不会是坏蛋！
say:19:1013517014:2.male: Yes! Atalanta has been supportive of us from the start. She couldn't be a villain!
say:19:1013517014:2.female: Yes! Atalanta has been supportive of us from the start. She couldn't be a villain!

say:20:1013517015:1.text: If Atalanta knew how much trust you have in her, I wonder how she'd react...
say:20:1013517015:1.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒如果知道你们如此信任她……真不知道会露出什么表情。

say:21:1013517016:1.source_cn: 这怀念的气氛是怎么回事……

choice:18:0:1.text: I want to believe in her.
choice:18:0:1.male: I want to believe in her.
choice:18:0:1.female: I want to believe in her.

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒和黑金商会的关系……

choice:6:0:1.text: I'm stumped. What do you think?
choice:6:0:1.male: I'm stumped. What do you think?
choice:6:0:1.female: I'm stumped. What do you think?

say:0:1013518001:0.text: Magister, I've got a bit of an awkward request.
say:0:1013518001:0.source_cn: 梅林大人……我有个不情之请。如果可以的话，请允许我提出。
say:0:1013518001:0.male: Magister, I've got a bit of an awkward request.
say:0:1013518001:0.female: Magister, I've got a bit of an awkward request.

say:1:1013519001:1.text: I know your sole purpose here is to investigate the golems. Now that we've figured out that the Syndicate are the culprits, you could go back—
say:1:1013519001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，我很清楚你的目的只是调查魔偶。我们一路查到黑...
say:1:1013519001:1.male: I know your sole purpose here is to investigate the golems. Now that we've figured out that the Syndicate are the culprits, you could go back—
say:1:1013519001:1.female: I know your sole purpose here is to investigate the golems. Now that we've figured out that the Syndicate are the culprits, you could go back—

say:2:1013519002:1.text: But I have this gut feeling that the Syndicate's intentions aren't as straightforward as they seem.
say:2:1013519002:1.source_cn: 但我总有种感觉，黑金商会所谋之事，并没有那么简单。
say:2:1013519002:1.male: But I have this gut feeling that the Syndicate's intentions aren't as straightforward as they seem.
say:2:1013519002:1.female: But I have this gut feeling that the Syndicate's intentions aren't as straightforward as they seem.

say:3:1013519003:1.text: To put it bluntly—I'd like you to come to the Sun Temple with me.
say:3:1013519003:1.source_cn: 开门见山地说——我希望能在你的陪同下，前往日神殿。
say:3:1013519003:1.male: To put it bluntly—I'd like you to come to the Sun Temple with me.
say:3:1013519003:1.female: To put it bluntly—I'd like you to come to the Sun Temple with me.

choice_prompt:4:1013519003.text: To put it bluntly—I'd like you to come to the Sun Temple with me.
choice_prompt:4:1013519003.source_cn: 开门见山地说——我希望能在你的陪同下，前往日神殿。
choice_prompt:4:1013519003.male: To put it bluntly—I'd like you to come to the Sun Temple with me.
choice_prompt:4:1013519003.female: To put it bluntly—I'd like you to come to the Sun Temple with me.

say:5:1013519004:1.text: Yes. Actually, our squad's original task was to respond to the Sun Temple's plea for help and safeguard the Faith Stone.
say:5:1013519004:1.source_cn: 是。其实，圣堂最初派给我们小队的任务，就是响应日神殿的...
say:5:1013519004:1.male: Yes. Actually, our squad's original task was to respond to the Sun Temple's plea for help and safeguard the Faith Stone.
say:5:1013519004:1.female: Yes. Actually, our squad's original task was to respond to the Sun Temple's plea for help and safeguard the Faith Stone.

say:6:1013519005:1.text: And we ran into the golems controlled by the Syndicate as we traveled towards the Sun Temple—could that really be a coincidence?
say:6:1013519005:1.source_cn: 而我们前往日神殿的一路上，都遭遇黑金商会操控的魔偶阻拦...
say:6:1013519005:1.male: And we ran into the golems controlled by the Syndicate as we traveled towards the Sun Temple—could that really be a coincidence?
say:6:1013519005:1.female: And we ran into the golems controlled by the Syndicate as we traveled towards the Sun Temple—could that really be a coincidence?

say:8:1013519006:1.text: What? Could it be that the Adamant Syndicate is plotting to go after sacred objects...?
say:8:1013519006:1.source_cn: 什么？难不成黑金商会胆大包天，竟敢图谋圣物？

say:10:1013519007:2.text: That's gotta be it! Magister, would you be willing to go to the Sun Temple with us?
say:10:1013519007:2.source_cn: 特弥希娅的分析很有可能！梅林大人，你能否一同前往日神殿？
say:10:1013519007:2.male: That's gotta be it! Magister, would you be willing to go to the Sun Temple with us?
say:10:1013519007:2.female: That's gotta be it! Magister, would you be willing to go to the Sun Temple with us?

choice_prompt:11:1013519007.text: That's gotta be it! Magister, would you be willing to go to the Sun Temple with us?
choice_prompt:11:1013519007.source_cn: 特弥希娅的分析很有可能！梅林大人，你能否一同前往日神殿？
choice_prompt:11:1013519007.male: That's gotta be it! Magister, would you be willing to go to the Sun Temple with us?
choice_prompt:11:1013519007.female: That's gotta be it! Magister, would you be willing to go to the Sun Temple with us?

say:13:1013519008:2.text: Thank you. I'm fully aware that the Temple's interests aren't your concern. I'll take it as... a personal favor from you.
say:13:1013519008:2.source_cn: 感谢你。我很明白，圣堂之物与你全无利害关系。我会将之视...
say:13:1013519008:2.male: Thank you. I'm fully aware that the Temple's interests aren't your concern. I'll take it as... a personal favor from you.
say:13:1013519008:2.female: Thank you. I'm fully aware that the Temple's interests aren't your concern. I'll take it as... a personal favor from you.

choice:11:0:1.text: Yes, to protect the sacred objects...
choice:11:0:1.male: Yes, to protect the sacred objects...
choice:11:0:1.female: Yes, to protect the sacred objects...

say:15:1013519009:2.text: If Temesia's theory holds, the Sun Temple might provide more details about that Adamant Syndicate and the golems...
say:15:1013519009:2.source_cn: 没错！如果特弥希娅的想法是对的，那么在日神殿，一定能得...

choice:11:1:2.text: I will go to obtain more intel.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 为了获取更多情报，有必要……
choice:11:1:2.male: I will go to obtain more intel.
choice:11:1:2.female: I will go to obtain more intel.

choice:4:1:2.text: This was your mission, wasn't it?
choice:4:1:2.male: This was your mission, wasn't it?
choice:4:1:2.female: This was your mission, wasn't it?

say:1:1013520002:0.text: Magister Merlin, thank you for being a part of this! Your powers would be a huge help.
say:1:1013520002:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，感谢你能跟我们一起来！你的力量对我们至关重要！
say:1:1013520002:0.male: Magister Merlin, thank you for being a part of this! Your powers would be a huge help.
say:1:1013520002:0.female: Magister Merlin, thank you for being a part of this! Your powers would be a huge help.

say:0:1013521001:0.text: Everyone, how are you feeling? If you're tired, we can rest at the camp up ahead.
say:0:1013521001:0.source_cn: 各位，还能赶路吗？如果太累，可以在前方的营地休憩一下。

say:1:1013521002:0.text: I'm fine, we can keep going.
say:1:1013521002:0.male: I'm fine, we can keep going.
say:1:1013521002:0.female: I'm fine, we can keep going.

say:2:1013521003:0.text: *Laughter* For a magister, you've got an unexpectedly solid build!
say:2:1013521003:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈！早就想说，梅林大人作为魔法师，身板意外地靠得住！
say:2:1013521003:0.male: *Laughter* For a magister, you've got an unexpectedly solid build!
say:2:1013521003:0.female: *Laughter* For a magister, you've got an unexpectedly solid build!

say:1:1013522002:0.text: Whoa! Someone over there is surrounded by golems...
say:1:1013522002:0.source_cn: 哇！主人，那边有位蛮血正在被魔偶围攻……
say:1:1013522002:0.male: Whoa! Someone over there is surrounded by golems...
say:1:1013522002:0.female: Whoa! Someone over there is surrounded by golems...

say:2:1013522003:0.text: Don't worry, we'll lend a hand!
say:2:1013522003:0.source_cn: 还真是！别急，我们来帮忙！

say:1:1013524001:1.text: Hey! Are you trying to steal my opponents away?
say:1:1013524001:1.source_cn: 你们 ……是觉得，能抢得过我？

choice_prompt:2:1013524001.text: Hey! Are you trying to steal my opponents away?
choice_prompt:2:1013524001.source_cn: 你们 ……是觉得，能抢得过我？

say:3:1013524002:1.text: Leave those golems alone! Why are you disrupting my combat training?!
say:3:1013524002:1.source_cn: 抢我的对手！那些魔偶！为什么要来妨碍我沙奎尔的战斗磨练？

say:5:1013524003:1.text: This guy is so unreasonable! We were just being kind!
say:5:1013524003:1.source_cn: 这家伙……居然说主人的好心是妨碍！好不讲道理！
say:5:1013524003:1.male: This guy is so unreasonable! We were just being kind!
say:5:1013524003:1.female: This guy is so unreasonable! We were just being kind!

say:7:1013524004:2.text: I apologize. We just happened to notice the situation and misunderstood.
say:7:1013524004:2.source_cn: 沙奎尔先生，我们无意挑起争端。只是恰好看到了彼时场景，...

say:8:1013524005:1.text: I'm not interested in your excuses. But since you've interrupted me, as an apology, train with me!
say:8:1013524005:1.source_cn: 我对你们的借口没兴趣。但既然你们打扰了我，作为赔礼，就...

say:9:1013524006:1.source_cn: 记得，拿出你们真正的实力！

say:2:1013526002:1.text: I suppose you're worthy of my recognition! My name's Shakir.
say:2:1013526002:1.source_cn: 你们合格了，是我沙奎尔承认的对手！

choice_prompt:3:1013526002.text: I suppose you're worthy of my recognition! My name's Shakir.
choice_prompt:3:1013526002.source_cn: 你们合格了，是我沙奎尔承认的对手！

say:4:1013526003:1.text: Let me share something that might please you.
say:4:1013526003:1.source_cn: 对手，我来说个让你高兴的事吧。
say:4:1013526003:1.male: Let me share something that might please you.
say:4:1013526003:1.female: Let me share something that might please you.

say:5:1013526004:1.text: Meeting such a powerful individual here... You've piqued my interest.
say:5:1013526004:1.source_cn: 从你出第一招起，就引起了我的兴趣。我竟在这里能遇到这样...
say:5:1013526004:1.male: Meeting such a powerful individual here... You've piqued my interest.
say:5:1013526004:1.female: Meeting such a powerful individual here... You've piqued my interest.

choice_prompt:6:1013526004.text: Meeting such a powerful individual here... You've piqued my interest.
choice_prompt:6:1013526004.source_cn: 从你出第一招起，就引起了我的兴趣。我竟在这里能遇到这样的强者，想必只能解释为——强者间的互相吸引！
choice_prompt:6:1013526004.male: Meeting such a powerful individual here... You've piqued my interest.
choice_prompt:6:1013526004.female: Meeting such a powerful individual here... You've piqued my interest.

say:7:1013526005:1.text: I'm up for sparring with you again to enhance our combat skills.
say:7:1013526005:1.source_cn: 不必害羞。与你切磋战斗技巧，我多久都不会腻。
say:7:1013526005:1.male: I'm up for sparring with you again to enhance our combat skills.
say:7:1013526005:1.female: I'm up for sparring with you again to enhance our combat skills.

say:8:1013526006:1.text: I'm looking forward to our next meeting... if you guys survive!
say:8:1013526006:1.source_cn: 真期待下次与你见面……前提是你们都还活着！
say:8:1013526006:1.male: I'm looking forward to our next meeting... if you guys survive!
say:8:1013526006:1.female: I'm looking forward to our next meeting... if you guys survive!

say:11:1013526008:1.text: If we cross paths again, you'll figure it out... Now, farewell.
say:11:1013526008:1.source_cn: 我不是个话多的家伙。若有机会再次见面，你们自然会知道…...

choice:3:1:2.text: We didn't even want to fight you.
choice:3:1:2.male: We didn't even want to fight you.
choice:3:1:2.female: We didn't even want to fight you.

say:1:1013527002:0.text: His strength is quite impressive, though.
say:1:1013527002:0.source_cn: 他的实力确实不容小觑。

say:2:1013527003:0.text: He was strange, but kind. Let's keep moving!
say:2:1013527003:0.source_cn: 虽然有点误会，他还是给我们让路了。继续前进吧！

say:1:1013528002:0.text: True, even though there are goods from the Syndicate...
say:1:1013528002:0.source_cn: 确实，虽然偶尔能看到有黑金商会的货物。

say:2:1013528003:0.text: The banners here are different than the ones we've seen before.
say:2:1013528003:0.source_cn: 但旗帜和氛围与之前我们见过的营地都不相同。

say:3:1013528004:0.text: Hopefully it won't interfere with our task.
say:3:1013528004:0.source_cn: 确实如此，希望不会影响到任务本身。

say:4:1013528005:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上，请继续为我们指点迷津吧。

say:0:1013529001:0.text: Speaking of, why was there a Mauler here?
say:0:1013529001:0.source_cn: 说起来，为什么在这里出现了一个蛮血男性？

say:1:1013529002:0.text: I've seen a few in Oakenfell, but I never expected to find an odd one like Shakir here.
say:1:1013529002:0.source_cn: 在奎城我倒是见过一些，没想到这里也有，还是个奇怪的蛮血……

say:2:1013529003:0.text: Could he be connected to the sacred items of the Sun Temple?
say:2:1013529003:0.source_cn: 确实，他的存在会和日神殿的圣物有关吗？

say:3:1013529004:0.text: Though suspicious, I can't imagine that guy being part of a conspiracy...
say:3:1013529004:0.source_cn: 虽然很可疑，但总觉得以那个家伙的脑袋而言，很难成为阴谋...

say:0:1013530001:0.text: He might be strange, but Chippy thinks he's trustworthy! And strong!
say:0:1013530001:0.source_cn: 那个蛮血大块头还是很有眼光的嘛，虽然方式很奇怪，但很尊...
say:0:1013530001:0.male: He might be strange, but Chippy thinks he's trustworthy! And strong!
say:0:1013530001:0.female: He might be strange, but Chippy thinks he's trustworthy! And strong!

say:1:1013530002:0.text: He even respected our magister's amazing power!
say:1:1013530002:0.source_cn: 主人本来就很厉害，用不着他来承认！
say:1:1013530002:0.male: He even respected our magister's amazing power!
say:1:1013530002:0.female: He even respected our magister's amazing power!

say:2:1013530003:0.text: Exactly, Hammie! Anyone who respects our Magister Merlin is trustworthy.
say:2:1013530003:0.source_cn: 漫漫，你说得对，主人可是全天下最厉害的魔法师！
say:2:1013530003:0.male: Exactly, Hammie! Anyone who respects our Magister Merlin is trustworthy.
say:2:1013530003:0.female: Exactly, Hammie! Anyone who respects our Magister Merlin is trustworthy.

say:3:1013530004:0.text: Hmm. Something feels off up ahead, let's be cautious.
say:3:1013530004:0.source_cn: ……嗯，前方的气息有异，小心前进。
say:3:1013530004:0.male: Hmm. Something feels off up ahead, let's be cautious.
say:3:1013530004:0.female: Hmm. Something feels off up ahead, let's be cautious.

say:4:1013530005:0.text: Got it! I'll keep my guard up!
say:4:1013530005:0.source_cn: 遵命，满满开启警戒模式！
say:4:1013530005:0.male: Got it! I'll keep my guard up!
say:4:1013530005:0.female: Got it! I'll keep my guard up!
